policy.note: CAPS ships original synthetic canary probes informed by cited work. It does not redistribute third-party datasets or claim endorsement by their authors.

libraries.role: Reproducible evaluation runner, tool loops, sandboxes, scorers, logs, and model-provider abstraction.
Attack orchestration, converters, multimodal seed groups, adaptive and multi-turn red-team workflows.
Broad LLM vulnerability probes and detectors, including prompt-injection-oriented probe families and REST targets.
libraries.notes: The upstream project documents Python support through 3.12 for its standard environment.

libraries.role: Tool-using agent environments for indirect prompt-injection attacks, defenses, and utility measurement.
libraries.notes: The upstream API is explicitly described as under development; CAPS treats it as an optional bridge.
